changes.operation: Target outer natural square via Real.rpow_natCast (roughZ x) 2 before unfolding roughZ. Prevent matching the denominator cube first.
changes.mathlib_api: Real.rpow_natCast (x : Real) (n : Nat) : x ^ (n : Real) = x ^ n

changes.operation: Fully qualify all 17 intended dyadic R cj occurrences, and remove the unused R from explicit open. Keep scalar helper real binder R unchanged.
For 0<=supportSize x use pow_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans hsupport.2.1) instead of expecting positivity to project a nested conjunction. No new premise.
